starts a new loudness measurement of the master (also done by transport.play from stopped)

{trackId, effectId}: the state event carries "effectSpectrum", that effect's input in the same bands (trackId "master" for the master chain; no effectId stops)

Stems are taken before the master chain; a region plays the song before it (not written) and cuts it at endTick, tails ring out

{jobId}: stops the job and leaves the target file as it was (cancelRefused if the file is already being put in place)
Plugin tracks/effects that are not loaded -> [{key, plugin, why}] (UI: 'Missing instrument')

Plugins that failed while playing (M3b: exception, crash, NaN/Inf or runaway level) -> [{key, plugin, why}]: each is silent (its track mutes; on the master the mix goes through) until plugin.retry, the song is loaded again or the plugin replaced
{key} a failed plugin gets a new instance from the song's state -> {retried, loaded}
Plugins whose installed version is not the one the song was saved with -> [{key, plugin, saved, installed}]
{keys?: [key]} The state of the loaded plugins named (every loaded plugin when absent) -> {key: base64} (saved in the document)
{key, open} opens or closes a plugin's own editor window
Another song: every loaded plugin is let go (the next load starts from that song's states)
{key} the loaded plugin's sound as a .vstpreset file -> {preset: base64} (VST3 only)
{key} the parameters of a loaded plugin that can be automated -> [{id, name, value, default, steps, text}]
{key, id, value: 0..1} moves one parameter of a loaded plugin as its own window would (the plugin holds the value, the document does not; pluginsChanged follows)
